source_doc: iHeart x Genuin - New Feature Proposal

entities.name: iHeartMedia
entities.description: Media company partnering with Genuin to amplify podcast engagement by auto-generating and distributing podcast clips across its ecosystem.

entities.name: iHeart App
entities.description: iHeartMedia's consumer app where creators connect podcasts, listeners play episodes, and clips are posted to community and social handles.

entities.name: Social Accounts Connect & Podcast Clip Share
entities.description: Proposed iHeart feature enabling talent and producers to connect podcasts and social handles, auto-generate clips, review them, and publish to community plus connected social media.

entities.name: Brand Control Center
entities.description: Genuin dashboard from which iHeart producers and admins can review generated clips and post them to communities and connected social handles.

entities.name: Clip Generator Agent
entities.description: Genuin AI agent that converts 1.5hr+ podcast audio/video into contextual short clips with hook, body, and CTA, plus captions and smart crop.

entities.name: Closed Captions
entities.description: Captioning capability included in the Clip Generator Agent output.

entities.name: Contextual Clips Generator
entities.description: Capability that produces contextual clips structured with an intro hook, body, and CTA outro.

entities.name: Contextual Titles Generator
entities.description: Capability that generates contextual titles for podcast clips.

entities.name: Smart Crop
entities.description: Active subject detection technology that reframes podcast video clips dynamically.

entities.name: Background Music Generator AI
entities.description: AI capability that generates background music for clips.

entities.name: Community Strategist Agent
entities.description: Genuin agent that organizes generated videos into the proper community and group.

entities.name: Thumbnail Generator
entities.description: Capability that generates thumbnails for clips.

entities.name: SEO Description Generator
entities.description: Capability that generates SEO-friendly descriptions for podcast clips.

entities.name: Virality Score
entities.description: Score derived from hook, flow, value, and trend dimensions to estimate a clip's virality.

entities.name: Multi-language Support
entities.description: Clip generation capability that supports over 110 languages.

entities.name: Repost by Users
entities.description: Allows iHeart users to repost content to multiple social accounts or other communities in one action.

entities.name: Remix for Creators
entities.description: Allows iHeart producers to remix a clip and repost it to other groups and social media handles.

entities.name: Download & Share
entities.description: Lets iHeart users download content with brand watermark to their device and share to other social platforms.

entities.name: Brand Watermark
entities.description: Watermark applied to downloaded clips so that shared content retains brand attribution across platforms.

entities.name: Play Podcast from Profile
entities.description: Listener flow that starts a creator's podcast when tapping the profile image on the creator profile page.

entities.name: Notification of Generated Clips
entities.description: Notifies producers and admins when new podcast clips have been generated and are ready to review.

entities.name: Elvis Duran
entities.description: iHeartMedia radio and podcast personality referenced as the talent whose podcast is played and whose posts are distributed to social platforms.

entities.name: iHeart Producers
entities.description: iHeartMedia producers and administrators who connect podcasts, review generated clips, and publish them to communities and social handles.

entities.name: iHeart Listeners
entities.description: End users of the iHeart App who play podcasts, repost content, and download or share clips.

entities.name: iHeart Community
entities.description: Community space within the iHeart App where producers post clips and users engage with content.

entities.name: X
entities.description: External social media platform to which iHeart producers and users can repost generated podcast clips.

entities.name: Instagram
entities.description: External social platform supported as a repost destination, including Instagram Story posts.

entities.name: LinkedIn
entities.description: External social platform supported as a repost destination for podcast clip content.

entities.name: TED
entities.description: Organization referenced as benefiting from creator/curator remixing of UGC content and boosted community engagement around shared ideas.

entities.name: Share of Voice Measurement
entities.description: Capability to identify which ideas resonate with users and spotlight them to enrich community discussions.

entities.name: Dynamic Text Adjustment
entities.description: Upcoming Genuin capability for dynamic text adjustment in clips.

entities.name: Non-Transcribable Video Processing
entities.description: Upcoming capability to process video that cannot be transcribed conventionally.

entities.name: Custom Caption Styles
entities.description: Upcoming feature offering custom caption styling for clips.

entities.name: Generative B-Rolls
entities.description: Upcoming capability to generate b-roll footage to enrich clips.

entities.name: Transitions
entities.description: Upcoming clip-editing feature adding transitions between scenes.

entities.name: Gifs Emojis and Stickers
entities.description: Upcoming feature to overlay gifs, emojis, and stickers on clips.

entities.name: Overlays
entities.description: Upcoming feature to add visual overlays to clips.

entities.name: Sound Effects
entities.description: Upcoming feature to add sound effects to generated clips.

entities.name: Clip Scheduling
entities.description: Upcoming capability to schedule clip posts.

entities.name: Multi-lingual Clips
entities.description: Upcoming feature delivering multilingual clip outputs.

entities.name: Clip Editor
entities.description: Upcoming editor capability for refining generated clips.

entities.name: Super Resolution
entities.description: Upcoming technology to upscale clip resolution.

entities.name: Community Sponsored Brands
entities.description: Sponsored brands element combined into community clip outputs alongside brand handle, logo, and assets.

relationships.source: Social Accounts Connect & Podcast Clip Share
relationships.description: The feature is delivered inside the iHeart App for producers and listeners.
iHeart App is owned and operated by iHeartMedia.
Producers and admins are iHeartMedia staff who manage podcast distribution.
Elvis Duran is an iHeartMedia podcast host featured in the proposal.
Elvis Duran's content is posted into the iHeart community.

relationships.source: Social Accounts Connect & Podcast Clip Share
relationships.description: The feature relies on the Clip Generator Agent to turn podcasts into short clips.
Closed captions are part of the agent's clip output.
Contextual clip generation with hook, body, and CTA is part of the agent.
Contextual title generation is part of the agent.
The agent uses smart crop with active subject detection to reframe videos.
The agent uses an AI background music generator for clip audio.
Thumbnail generation is part of the agent's output.
SEO-friendly description generation is part of the agent's output.
The agent supports 110+ languages.
The agent produces a virality score based on hook, flow, value, and trend.
The Community Strategist Agent organizes generated videos into the appropriate iHeart community and groups.

relationships.target: Social Accounts Connect & Podcast Clip Share

Notifications about generated clips are sent to producers and admins.
Playing a podcast from a creator's profile page is a flow in the iHeart App.
iHeart listeners use the profile-tap interaction to play podcasts.
Repost by Users is a feature for iHeart listeners to redistribute content.
Users can repost iHeart clips to X.
Users can repost iHeart clips to Instagram, including Stories.
Users can repost iHeart clips to LinkedIn.
Remix is provided to iHeart producers for re-editing and reposting clips.
Downloaded clips carry a brand watermark when shared off-platform.
Download & Share is offered to iHeart listeners.
The share-of-voice measurement is framed as a benefit for the TED community.
Dynamic Text Adjustment is on the roadmap for clip generation.
Non-transcribable video processing is an upcoming capability.
Custom caption styles are an upcoming clip feature.
Generative b-rolls are upcoming for richer clip composition.
Transitions are upcoming for clip editing.
Gifs, emojis, and stickers are upcoming overlay capabilities.
Overlays are upcoming for clip visuals.
Sound effects are upcoming for clip audio.
Scheduling is upcoming for clip posting.
Multi-lingual clip output is upcoming.
An editor is upcoming for refining clips.
Super resolution is an upcoming technology in the clip pipeline.
Community-sponsored brand elements appear in iHeart community clip outputs.
iHeart distributes podcast clips to X as a connected social platform.
iHeart distributes podcast clips to Instagram as a connected social platform.
iHeart distributes podcast clips to LinkedIn as a connected social platform.
